rows.grounds: instrumental plural of the atisāra-ādi compound; by diarrhea and similar disorders

items.question: What suffering arises from diarrhea and similar abdominal faults?
premises: Diarrhea and similar faults are abdominal.
items.inference: Abdominal disorders such as diarrhea cause suffering.
uncertainties: Exact optative force of āvahet remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Diarrhea and similar abdominal faults would bring suffering.
